description: Get transaction history for a TRON address via TronGrid REST API. Returns a compact summary per transaction. Use a small limit and paginate with fingerprint to control response size

fingerprint.description: Pagination cursor from previous response meta.fingerprint — pass to fetch the next page

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-200, default 10). Start small to avoid large responses; use fingerprint to paginate for more

name: get_transaction_history
